timeline.body:
Motivation:

Add support for HAProxyMessageEncoder.
This should help java based HAProxy server implementations propagate proxy information.

Modification:

Add public constructors for `HAProxyMessage`, `HAProxyTLV`, `HAProxySSLTLV`.
Add additional argument checks for `HAProxyMessage` and modify exceptions thrown when creating via public constructors directly.
Introduce a `@Sharable` `HAProxyMessageEncoder` which encodes a `HAProxyMessage` into a byte array.
Add an example `HAProxyServer` and `HAProxyClient` to `io.netty.example`


Result:

Fixes #10164
Can one of the admins verify this patch?

@jrhee17 please sign our icla and let me know once done:

https://netty.io/s/icla

reply.body:
I think we have a couple of options:
1) Pad the string to 108 length, and use `writeCharSequence `
    -> I'm not sure the extra string allocation will be worth it. I don't think readability will improve either, since we still need to 1) get the size of the address in bytes 2) allocate a new 108 byte length string 3) and write to `ByteBuffer`.
2) Restrict user input to accept only 108 byte addresses
    -> usability 😢 
3) Keep AS-IS

I prefer 3, but might be willing to change to 1) if you wish

timeline.body:
One thing that keeps bugging me is the `HAProxySSLTLV` implementation.

1. When decoded via `HAProxyMessageDecoder`, the `ByteBufHolder.content()` contains the entire raw content. (`client`, `verify`, `tlvs`)
2. When instantiating, the content isn't set.
https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/2699088dbba8bd30bb907056f70feaec0f064b31/codec-haproxy/src/main/java/io/netty/handler/codec/haproxy/HAProxySSLTLV.java#L45

Technically, I don't think `HAProxySSLTLV` should be extending `ByteBufHolder` in the first place, but I am yet to find a clean solution.

Otherwise, I feel pretty good about the rest of the pr.
Just a few more small things... After that we are ready to go...
@jrhee17 maybe I am missing something but isn't the `HAProxySSLTLV`  thingy pre-existing ? If so I think we can't change it anyway atm...
